subject: reading or downloading data from server

messages.subject: reading or downloading data from server
parts:
I have an app that saves user data in a subdirectory where my shiny app is hosted. What is the best way to store the data and access it?

One approach would be to periodically download the data from and delete it on the server (to prevent it from using up too much space on the server). 

How best to do that?

Thanks!
